records.assessableCompetence: Derive and balance a stipulated redox transformation using formal oxidation-number and electron accounting.
records.minimalityReason: Deriving oxidation numbers, identifying the change and obtaining balanced coefficients are successive steps applied to the same reaction. A correct isolated number without a valid balance is an incomplete execution of this procedure, rather than a separate completed competence. The organic case applies the same accounting to local carbon atoms.
records.separabilityCountercheck: The neutralization counterexample tests the boundary of the same classification procedure. No additional synthesis, actual permanganate measurement or mechanistic explanation is claimed. Splitting merely by inorganic/organic format or by the successive verbs would fragment the procedure.
records.requiresAndParentContext: The Redoxreaktionen parent contains separate redox-concept, redox-series, galvanic-cell and electrolysis goals. Their performances are not imported into this goal. The current indicator prerequisite may merit separate didactic-edge review; it does not make the goal body a bundle of competences.
records.remainingBoundary: The English scope omission and source aliases/locators remain separate D and source work. No source repair or V approval is issued.

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Oxidationszahlen bestimmen und bilanzieren
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Oxidationszahlen für Atome in anorganischen und organischen Teilchen herleiten, Redoxreaktionen identifizieren und Redoxgleichungen mithilfe von Oxidationszahlen ausgleichen.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can derive oxidation numbers for atoms in compounds and balance redox equations using oxidation numbers.

records.assessableCompetence: Quantitatively plan, prepare and check a specified dilute strong-acid or strong-base solution using its pH.
records.minimalityReason: Required amount determines aliquot and final volume; dissociation determines expected ion concentration and pH; preparation and comparison check the same produced solution. The cases bind these steps into one working product. Separately scoring constituent skills does not by itself establish a list of unrelated routines.
records.separabilityCountercheck: Existing 1351706 covers preparation from a supplied instruction. This goal builds independently quantified and chemically validated preparation on that prerequisite. The hydroxide stoichiometry and measurement discrepancy change how that same routine is performed. Existing c224 overlaps in pH calculation; overlap is a mapping or duplication question, not automatic proof that f1ed contains unrelated performance objects.
records.requiresAndParentContext: Current prerequisites include instructed preparation, Arrhenius foundations and indicator distinction. The Protolysereaktionen parent separately contains titration and concept goals. Those additional operations are not imported.
records.remainingBoundary: ATOMIC applies to the current strong-solution routine. It does not extend the goal to weak acids/bases, buffers, salts or titration. The English omission of preparation remains a D issue. Practical mastery requires actual independent evidence.

records.assessableCompetence: The current body combines conjugate-pair/equilibrium-direction comparison with an independently performed indicator test.
records.minimalityReason: A learner can correctly compare acid/base strengths and favored proton transfer without being able to perform an indicator test. Conversely, controlled color/reference comparison can be performed without Ka or equilibrium-direction reasoning. The original cases expressly separate unknown X/Y/Z samples from the reaction mixture; case 2 likewise uses separate laboratory samples. This is substantive separability, rather than a finding based only on conjunctions.
records.separabilityCountercheck: Finite K, partner-dependent roles and absence of kinetic predictions are direct quality conditions of pair/direction reasoning. They need not become a third goal. Practical detection, however, has separate apparatus, acquisition evidence and an existing carrier, d2ccd1d5.
records.requiresAndParentContext: Only Brønsted concept goal 1c1420c2 is a current explicit prerequisite. Existing d2ccd1d5 carries indicator distinction. Quantitative Ka/K derivation needs additional taught equilibrium knowledge; pK goal 48115 is not a current prerequisite of b477.
records.boundedRecommendationWithoutMutation: Review a separation between the stable pair/direction core and the existing practical indicator carrier, preserving the actual detection operator. This finding decides no new IDs or specific wording, edges or applicability. Any successor scope requires substantive case review.
records.remainingBoundary: The supplied author mapping input gives one direct HB strength/equilibrium witness with partner 48115. This establishes neither sixteen-state coverage nor source approval of the complete detection operator. A valid P design does not overturn the NON_ATOMIC finding.
